entry.smoke: fail: no chromedriver runs on XP and speaks Chromium 122's DevTools
entry.notes: win32ss/supermium publishes no chromedriver asset (checked all releases incl. v122-r5/r6, and the nonsetup zips). Official chromedriver 122.0.6261.128 (CfT win32) and 109.0.5414.74 exit 0xC0000139 on XP; chromedriver 2.22-2.46 same. chromedriver 2.21 (last that loads on XP) launches Supermium headless but session creation fails: 'Runtime.executionContextCreated has invalid context' (DevTools protocol too new for it), and it only reads the legacy 'chromeOptions' key.
